Stephens was ejected, following a late hit to the head of Oregon quarterback Dante Moore, who was attempting to slide. Moore was taken off the field in a stretcher and taken away in an ambulance during the Ducks' 41-27 victory over the Trojans. CBS Sports reported Moore sustained a concussion. Stephens also drew criticism for his apparent reaction on the sideline, and his decision to stay on the sideline in sweatpants after being ejected. "He understands his mistake, accepts the consequences of his actions and will learn from this," USC head coach Lincoln Riley said. "The entire Trojan Family wishes Dante a full recovery, and we send our best regards to him and his family." Stephens issued an apology Sunday, expressing regrets for his actions. "Seeing a player injured like that is incredibly serious, and my reaction in the moments afterward was completely inappropriate and inexcusable," Stephens said in the statement. "Regardless of what was going through my mind at the time, there is no justification for smiling or celebrating while another player receives medical attention. I take full responsibility for my actions. That is not the person or teammate I want to be, and I will learn from this. I am deeply sorry to Dante, his family and everyone who saw my reaction. It is not representative of USC or our program. I hope he makes a full and speedy recovery." Stephens will miss USC's home game against Washington on Oct. 3. He has 19 tackles in five games, his third season with the Trojans. --Field Level Media

item.title: El presidente de Serbia, Vucic, dimite antes de las elecciones parlamentarias de octubre
item.description: El presidente populista de Serbia, Aleksandar Vucic, anunció su dimisión el domingo, poniendo fin a su segundo y último mandato de cinco años y allanando el camino para la celebración de elecciones presidenciales anticipadas.
item.dc:creator: Aleksandar Vasovic
item.content:encoded: El presidente populista de Serbia, Aleksandar Vucic, anunció su dimisión el domingo, poniendo fin a su segundo y último mandato de cinco años y allanando el camino para la celebración de elecciones presidenciales anticipadas. La dimisión de Vucic, siete meses antes de que finalice su mandato, se produce en plena campaña para las elecciones parlamentarias anticipadas de Serbia, previstas para el 25 de octubre, y le permite ser nombrado primer ministro si su Partido Progresista de Serbia (SNS) forma el nuevo Gobierno. Cientos de seguidores de Vucic lo vitorearon frente al edificio de la Presidencia, en el centro de Belgrado. "Ésta es mi última noche en este edificio", declaró a la multitud que agitaba banderas minutos antes de presentar su dimisión. "Les he servido fielmente a ustedes y a mi patria, Serbia... Estoy orgulloso de lo que hemos logrado juntos", afirmó. Según la Constitución serbia, la presidenta saliente del Parlamento, Ana Brnabic, ejercerá como presidenta interina hasta que se elija a un nuevo presidente. Las elecciones presidenciales deben celebrarse en un plazo de 90 días, y la campaña durará entre 30 y 60 días. "A finales de diciembre… tendremos la primera vuelta de las elecciones presidenciales", afirmó Vucic, quien ya había anunciado a principios de verano su intención de dimitir como presidente. Las elecciones parlamentarias anticipadas del próximo mes enfrentarán al SNS de Vucic y a sus aliados contra "Students Win", un movimiento anticorrupción liderado por estudiantes, y "Serbia Europea", una alianza de partidos de la oposición prooccidentales. "Students Win", "Serbia Europea" y otros partidos aún tienen que designar a sus candidatos a la presidencia.

item.title: L'Iran insiste sur une solution diplomatique après le rejet du plan de paix par Trump
item.description: L'Iran a réaffirmé dimanche que seule la diplomatie pouvait résoudre son conflit avec les États-Unis et Israël, réagissant au rejet par le président américain Donald Trump de la proposition de Téhéran visant à rouvrir le détroit d'Ormuz et à mettre fin aux combats.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: L'Iran a réaffirmé dimanche que seule la diplomatie pouvait résoudre son conflit avec les États-Unis et Israël, réagissant au rejet par le président américain Donald Trump de la proposition de Téhéran visant à rouvrir le détroit d'Ormuz et à mettre fin aux combats. "Nos conditions sont claires, et toute initiative visant à rouvrir le détroit d'Ormuz dépend du respect de ces conditions" a déclaré le ministre iranien des Affaires étrangères, Abbas Araqchi, sur les réseaux sociaux. "Seule une solution négociée peut les sortir de cette impasse". Plus tôt, il avait que l'Iran attendrait que les médiateurs lui transmettent la position définitive des Etats-Unis et prendra une décision en fonction de celle-ci. L'Iran a présenté aux Etats-Unis, par l'intermédiaire de médiateurs qataris, un plan [USN:L8N45H1K7 TEXT:""concret""] pour rouvrir le détroit d'Ormuz et mettre fin aux hostilités en sept jours lors de l'Assemblée générale des Nations unies à New York. Samedi, Donald Trump a dit [USN:L8N45I033 TEXT:"rejeter"] cette proposition. Laissant toutefois la porte ouverte à la diplomatie, Donald Trump a déclaré dimanche à Axios lors d’un entretien téléphonique qu’il s’attendait à ce que les négociateurs américains engagent de nouvelles discussions cette semaine. L'armée iranienne est prête à faire face à toute nouvelle attaque américaine, a déclaré pour sa part le porte-parole de l'armée iranienne Mohammad Akraminia d'après des médias d'État. Il a affirmé que son pays était prêt à une confrontation, et a averti que les États-Unissubiraient des dégâts plus importants s'ils lançaient une nouvelle attaque contre l'Iran. Le commandant en chef de l'armée iranienne, Amir Hatami, a dit que la guerre était entrée dans une phase critique et décisive, ajoutant que Téhéran n'accepterait pas une situation dans laquelle l'Iran serait incapable de commercer tandis que des puissances étrangères utiliseraient les voies navigables stratégiques de la région. "Si l'Iran ne peut pas faire d'échanges commerciaux, si l’Iran ne peut pas vivre, personne ne pourra commercer ni vivre. Le détroit d’Ormuz est le détroit de notre dignité et de notre honneur, et nous ne permettrons pas aux ennemis du pays d’utiliser ce goulet d’étranglement logistique majeur alors que le peuple iranien en est privé", a-t-il déclaré.

item.title: Furacão Polo, de categoria 3, ameaça costa do México e deve atingir continente na 2ª feira
item.description: Meteorologistas afirmaram que o furacão Polo, que perdeu força e agora é classificado como uma tempestade de categoria 3, deve atingir a costa do Pacífico da Baja California Sur na noite de segunda-feira, trazendo ventos sustentados de 97 a 129 km/h e chuvas fortes para o popular destino turístico.
item.dc:creator: Emily Green
item.content:encoded: Meteorologistas afirmaram que o furacão Polo, que perdeu força e agora é classificado como uma tempestade de categoria 3, deve atingir a costa do Pacífico da Baja California Sur na noite de segunda-feira, trazendo ventos sustentados de 97 a 129 km/h e chuvas fortes para o popular destino turístico. Às 11h (horário da costa leste dos EUA) deste domingo, o furacão estava a cerca de 320 km da costa da Baixa Califórnia, avançando para norte noroeste a 19 km/h, com ventos sustentados de 201 km/h, segundo o Centro Nacional de Furacões dos EUA. A empresa privada de previsão meteorológica AccuWeather informou que o Polo deve enfraquecer gradualmente antes de atingir a costa como um furacão de categoria 1, mas ainda assim pode derrubar árvores e linhas de energia e causar danos estruturais. Chuvas intensas, ondas altas e ventos fortes já provocaram retiradas de pessoas, fechamento de portos e cancelamento de aulas ao longo da costa do Pacífico do México. Na cidade turística de San José del Cabo, autoridades restringiram o acesso às praias, já que a tempestade gerou ondas grandes e correntes perigosas. A estimativa é que o Polo leve de 10 a 20 cm de chuva em toda a Baja California, aumentando o risco de inundações e deslizamentos de terra potencialmente fatais, antes de cruzar o Golfo da Califórnia e seguir para os Estados do norte de Sonora e Chihuahua.

item.title: Serbie Démission du président Aleksandar Vucic
item.description: Le président serbe Aleksandar Vucic a annoncé dimanche sa démission, ouvrant la voie à des élections présidentielles anticipées.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Le président serbe Aleksandar Vucic a annoncé dimanche sa démission, ouvrant la voie à des élections présidentielles anticipées. Au début du mois, le dirigeant populiste, en fonction depuis 12 ans en tant que président ou chef du gouvernement, a [USN:L6N4510S2 TEXT:"dissous"] le Parlement et annoncé la tenue d'élections anticipées le 25 octobre, dans un tentative visant à prolonger son emprise sur le pouvoir en se présentant à nouveau au poste de Premier ministre. Aleksandar Vucic a été confronté à des manifestations anti-corruption déclenchées par l'effondrement, en novembre 2024, du toit de la gare de la ville de Novi Sad, dans le nord du pays, qui a tué 16 personnes.

item.title: Bill Gates appelle à son tour à mieux encadrer l'IA
item.description: L'intelligence artificielle (IA) doit être encadrée bien au-delà d'un seul dispositif d'autorégulation, a déclaré Bill Gates, cofondateur de Microsoft, appelant le Congrès américain à adopter une législation en la matière.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: L'intelligence artificielle (IA) doit être encadrée bien au-delà d'un seul dispositif d'autorégulation, a déclaré Bill Gates, cofondateur de Microsoft, appelant le Congrès américain à adopter une législation en la matière. "(...) Les responsables politiques ne devraient pas avoir le choix que de commencer à participer à la discussion concernant les garde-fous et la surveillance nécessaires" a-t-il dit sur l'émission 'Meet the Press' de NBC, diffusée dimanche. Depuis quelques semaines, le débat sur les dangers potentiels de l'IA fait rage, notamment l'appel de Dario Amodei, directeur général d'Anthropic, à [USN:L6N454074 TEXT:"ralentir"] le développement des modèles IA - un appel soutenu par Elon Musk, qui dirige xAI, et par Sam Altman, directeur général d'OpenAI. Outre l'encouragement du directeur général de l'entreprise à freiner son développement, d'autres mises en garde sur l'IA ont jeté un froid sur l'euphorie - à en juger des centaines de milliards de dollars investis - sur cette nouvelle révolution technologique. Au cours des deux dernières semaines, certains des chercheurs d'Anthropic ont averti que l'IA pourrait conduire à l'extinction de l'humanité d'ici la fin de la décennie et l'entreprise a également déclaré avoir découvert des exemples où ses systèmes auraient pu être utilisés pour le développement [USN:L6N4530N7 TEXT:"d'armes biologiques"].

item.title: After turbulent summer, England head into winter schedule
item.description: England’s emphatic win over Sri Lanka in the last clash of their three-match One Day International series on Sunday brought down the curtain on a tumultuous home summer but there will be hardly any rest as the team head out on the road.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: England’s emphatic win over Sri Lanka in the last clash of their three-match One Day International series on Sunday brought down the curtain on a tumultuous home summer but there will be hardly any rest as the team head out on the road. The sudden and shock retirement of captain Ben Stokes, the sacking of Brendon McCullum as test coach and more off-field incidents punctuated recent months as England played Test series against New Zealand and Pakistan and beat both India and Sri Lanka in ODI and Twenty20 contests. They suffered a 2-1 Test series defeat to New Zealand, with Stokes quitting and [USN:L6N43E059 TEXT:"McCullum being sacked"], although he kept his role as coach of the ODI and T20 teams. Stokes had been left out for the second test against New Zealand in June after breaking a team curfew and then [USN:L4N43002A TEXT:"announced his retirement"] from international cricket during the third test, which they went on to lose by 160 runs, citing exhaustion. With Joe Root returning as captain, England were back on track with a one-sided 3-0 Test series win over Pakistan, who were hampered by their own problems and proved disjointed opponents. But even then the build-up to the second Test was overshadowed by an incident involving bowler Brydon Carse outside a nightclub in Derby, where he was handcuffed by police and then dropped from the England squad. Root described himself as "hacked off" by the growing list of alcohol-related incidents involving England players after the controversy of last winter’s tours, including Harry Brook being fined £30,000 ($41,000) following an altercation in Wellington as well as reports of drinking during a mid-Ashes series trip to Noosa. Now they go off again for winter action, with a tri-series next month in Pakistan that also includes Sri Lanka, then three ODIs and five T20s in Australia followed by a three-Test series in South Africa with former New Zealand captain Stephen Fleming as the new Test coach. Fleming has promised a more measured approach to the Test side after Stokes and McCullum introduced a brand of cricket quickly nicknamed "Bazball". England also have three ODIs in South Africa, who co-host the 2027 Cricket World Cup next October, and the one-off, pink ball, day-night 150th anniversary of Test cricket clash against Australia in Melbourne in March. "I would love to be in charge of the number one Test team in the world. That would be my aspiration," Fleming said last week.

item.title: French far-right leaders say they have won enough seats to form Senate caucus
item.description: French far-right leaders said their party, the National Rally, and its right-wing allies won enough seats in Sunday's indirect election of senators to form their own caucus.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: French far-right leaders said their party, the National Rally, and its right-wing allies won enough seats in Sunday's indirect election of senators to form their own caucus. It was the first time the party had cleared the 10-seat threshold for a Senate caucus, as it prepares for a 2027 presidential race in which [USN:L1N45507C TEXT:"opinion polls show it in the lead"] for the first round. "The results have exceeded our expectations," Marine Le Pen, the party's leader and presidential candidate, said in a post on X. Le Pen is seeking to win the presidency in the two-round election in the spring, but previous attempts by the far right to reach the country's highest elected office have repeatedly been blocked. Of the 348 seats in the upper chamber, 178 were up for grabs in Sunday's election. The party did not say how many seats it had won. Senators are elected by lawmakers in the National Assembly and local elected representatives. Group leaders are able to request votes, among other powers.

item.title: Hezbollah planeja contribuir com projeto para deslocados libaneses
item.description: O grupo libanês Hezbollah, apoiado pelo Irã, afirmou neste domingo que contribuirá em breve para um projeto que visa abrigar milhares de pessoas deslocadas devido à guerra com Israel.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O grupo libanês Hezbollah, apoiado pelo Irã, afirmou neste domingo que contribuirá em breve para um projeto que visa abrigar milhares de pessoas deslocadas devido à guerra com Israel. O anúncio foi feito pelo líder do Hezbollah, Naim Qassem, durante um discurso em evento que marcou o segundo aniversário do assassinato do líder Hassan Nasrallah por Israel, em 2024. “O partido (Hezbollah) está comprometido em fornecer abrigo, restauração e reconstrução com os recursos disponíveis e as doações. Os detalhes de um novo projeto habitacional para moradores de aldeias que foram completamente destruídas serão anunciados em breve”, disse Qassem. Qassem afirmou que o Estado libanês deveria ter assumido a responsabilidade pelo abrigo e pela indenização dos deslocados. “Ainda é seu dever cumprir suas responsabilidades em relação ao abrigo, à indenização e a todas as obrigações relacionadas à reconstrução e à restauração”, disse ele. Mais de um milhão de pessoas, representando quase um quarto da população do Líbano, foram deslocadas após o início de uma nova guerra entre as forças armadas de Israel e o Hezbollah no início de março. A maioria já retornou às suas casas, mas mais de 340 mil continuam deslocadas porque suas cidades foram destruídas ou estão localizadas em áreas ocupadas pelas forças armadas israelenses. Desde 2 de março, os ataques israelenses mataram mais de 4.300 pessoas no Líbano, incluindo mais de 250 crianças, e feriram outras 12.000, incluindo 1.000 crianças.

item.title: Russian attacks kills three in Ukrainian cities, nine injured in Kyiv strikes, officials say
item.description: Russian attacks killed three people in two different Ukrainian cities on Sunday and struck districts of the capital Kyiv, local officials said. Kyiv Mayor Vitali Klitschko said ...

Russian attacks kills three in Ukrainian cities, nine injured in Kyiv strikes, officials say

Sept 27 (Reuters) – Russian attacks killed three people in two different Ukrainian cities on Sunday and struck districts of the capital Kyiv, local officials said.

Kyiv Mayor Vitali Klitschko said nine people were injured in the capital, including a child. Six of the injured were being treated in hospital.

Russian forces have long staged intensive attacks on Kyiv and other Ukrainian cities, mostly at night. In recent weeks, they have launched strikes almost continuously throughout the day.

Show Full Article

Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy decried the latest attacks, saying the civilian targets made the acts unquestionably “terrorism”.

“Russia has no military objective whatsoever in doing this,” Zelenskiy wrote in a post on X. “It is purely an attempt to break people and inflict as much harm as possible on our society.”

In the northern city of Sumy, a frequent Russian target near the border, three glide bombs struck near a family support centre, killing two people, regional governor Oleh Hryhorov wrote on Telegram.

Russia has long said it intends to turn areas of the Sumy region into a buffer zone.

In Kharkiv, Ukraine’s second-largest city in the northeast and another frequent target, a drone struck a car, killing the driver, prosecutors said.

Zelenskiy said Russia had deployed 277 attack drones of various types since Saturday, 155 of them of the jet-powered variety Moscow has recently used more readily as they fly higher and are difficult to intercept.

He said the targets in Kyiv had included a building used as a residence by the Saudi Arabian ambassador.

DATA CENTRES AND A PLAYGROUND

Kyiv Mayor Klitschko said a drone had struck a high-rise apartment building, triggering a fire in an eastern suburb and wounding one person. Emergency crews extinguished the blaze.

Drones hit areas near a kindergarten and a playground in two districts, Klitschko said on Telegram, and other areas in the city also suffered damage, though no casualties were reported.

Drone debris had triggered a fire in another Kyiv district, he said.

Ukraine’s largest mobile service provider told the Interfax Ukraine news agency that Russian forces had hit its headquarters in continued strikes on Ukrainian data centres and communications infrastructure. There were no casualties.

Russia’s defence ministry issued statements saying its forces had struck two data centres in Kyiv, a logistics hub in Odesa, as well as two cargo vessels headed for Odesa.

Both sides in the more than 4-1/2-year-old war deny targeting civilians.

(Reporting by Ron Popeski; Editing by Mark Porter and Bill Berkrot)

item.title: Israel revoga status de diplomatas holandeses em Ramallah
item.description: O Ministério das Relações Exteriores de Israel informou neste domingo que revogou o status diplomático dos diplomatas holandeses no Escritório de Representação da Holanda em Ramallah.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O Ministério das Relações Exteriores de Israel informou neste domingo que revogou o status diplomático dos diplomatas holandeses no Escritório de Representação da Holanda em Ramallah. A decisão ocorre em resposta à proibição do governo holandês às importações de produtos originários dos assentamentos israelenses na Cisjordânia ocupada. O status diplomático dos diplomatas holandeses deve expirar em sete dias, informou o ministério israelense.

item.title: Reports: LSU LB Whit Weeks suffers fracture in leg
item.description: LSU senior linebacker Whit Weeks has suffered a fracture in right leg, according to multiple sources.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: LSU senior linebacker Whit Weeks has suffered a fracture in right leg, according to multiple sources. Weeks exited in the third quarter of Saturday's 35-6 win over Texas A&M. It is not the first significant injury for the 21-year-old. Last season, he missed five games due to a leg injury. In 2024, he was a first-team All-SEC selection, racking up 125 combined tackles, 10 tackles for loss, 3.5 sacks, two forced fumbles, and one interception. This season, Weeks has posted 24 combined tackles and 2.5 tackles for loss across four games. --Field Level Media

item.title: 米軍が使う英空軍基地周辺でテロ計画か、5人逮捕－イラン関与も捜査
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 英国の警察は27日、米軍も使用するフェアフォード空軍基地への攻撃を計画していたとみられる男5人を逮捕した。トランプ米大統領は、容疑者らが基地に「大きな損害を与えようとしていた」とし、攻撃を未然に防いだことを「素晴らしい」と評価した。

同基地は米軍の対イラン攻撃で重要な出撃拠点となっている。匿名を条件に語った関係者によると、英警察は、計画がかなり進んだ段階で阻止された重大な攻撃未遂事件とみて、動機の解明を進めている。

当局はイラン政府の関与があったかどうかも調べているという。ただ、捜査は継続中で、別の動機が浮上する可能性もあると関係者は述べた。

警察は当初、爆発物法違反の疑いで男5人を逮捕。その後、テロ行為を準備した疑いでも逮捕した。

与党・労働党の年次党大会でリバプールを訪れていたバーナム英首相は、今回の事件を「極めて憂慮すべきだ」とした上で、「地域社会を守り、国の安全を確保するため、政府は必要なあらゆる措置を講じる」と強調した。

英政府当局者によると、ストリーティング国防相は27日、ヘグセス米国防長官と電話会談を行った。フェアフォード空軍基地は、米空軍が欧州に爆撃機を前方展開する際の主要拠点となっている。

英国は現在、さまざまな安全保障上の脅威に直面しており、事件の動機として考えられるものは少なくない。

英政府はここ数カ月に起きた複数の反ユダヤ主義的な事件について、イランの支援を受ける勢力が関与したとの見方を公に示している。一方、イスラム過激主義に触発された脅威も高まっている。これとは別に、イスラエルによるガザでの戦争に反対する左派活動家が近年、英国の軍事基地に繰り返し侵入している。

原題：Trump Says Suspects in UK Incident Sought to Damage Shared Base（抜粋）

--取材協力：Ellen Milligan、Maria Paula Mijares Torres、Courtney Subramanian、Brendan Scott.

item.title: Boston Bruins bestow captaincy on David Pastrnak
item.description: The Boston Bruins named right wing David Pastrnak as the 28th team captain in franchise history, the team announced Sunday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Boston Bruins named right wing David Pastrnak as the 28th team captain in franchise history, the team announced Sunday. Pastrnak is a four-time NHL All-Star. During the 2019-20 season, he was tied with Alexander Ovechkin for the NHL lead in goals (48). Last season, the 12-year veteran led the Bruins in both points (100) and assists (71). He also chipped in 29 goals and posted a +4 plus/minus. The captain vacancy had been open since Brad Marchand was traded to the Florida Panthers in March 2025. Now, the 30-year-old Pastrnak will officially claim the title as the team's leader. --Field Level Media

item.title: Nick Chubb retires as member of Browns
item.description: Running back Nick Chubb officially retired as a member of the Cleveland Browns. He was honored during Sunday's game against the Carolina Panthers.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Running back Nick Chubb officially retired as a member of the Cleveland Browns. He was honored during Sunday's game against the Carolina Panthers. "It's great to be back," Chubb said in a press conference. "Cleveland is where my journey started, and this is where it's going to end." Chubb spent seven of his eight NFL seasons with the Browns, earning four Pro Bowl selections. He finished third in franchise history in both rushing yards (6,843) and rushing touchdowns (51), trailing only Jim Brown and Leroy Kelly. In 2023, he suffered a knee injury against the Pittsburgh Steelers that caused him to miss 21 consecutive games. Once he returned in 2024, he posted a career-low 3.3 yards per carry. He spent his final season with the Houston Texans in 2025, rushing for 506 yards and three touchdowns. --Field Level Media

item.title: Ministro das Relações Exteriores da Alemanha diz que reunião com Lavrov foi motivada por preocupações com segurança
item.description: O ministro das Relações Exteriores da Alemanha, Johann Wadephul, afirmou neste domingo que sua decisão de se reunir com seu homólogo russo, Sergei Lavrov, foi motivada por preocupações com a área de segurança e pela necessidade de abordar a crescente crise nas exportações de alimentos.
item.dc:creator: Maria Martinez
item.content:encoded: O ministro das Relações Exteriores da Alemanha, Johann Wadephul, afirmou neste domingo que sua decisão de se reunir com seu homólogo russo, Sergei Lavrov, foi motivada por preocupações com a área de segurança e pela necessidade de abordar a crescente crise nas exportações de alimentos. Lavrov e Wadephul se encontraram em Nova York, à margem da Assembleia Geral das Nações Unidas, no sábado, marcando as primeiras conversas do tipo desde antes da invasão da Ucrânia pela Rússia em 2022. Wadephul afirmou que a suposta implantação de drones armados pela Rússia no aeroporto de Leipzig havia ultrapassado os limites e tornado necessário comunicar diretamente que a Alemanha estava preparada para se defender. “A Rússia precisa entender que estamos prontos para resistir e nos defender”, disse Wadephul em entrevista à ARD. A reunião também ocorreu em meio a esforços diplomáticos para retomar as exportações de grãos e energia da Rússia e da Ucrânia pelo Mar Negro, drasticamente reduzidas por ataques a navios e à infraestrutura portuária. “Vários pares, especialmente do Sul Global, me pediram para conversar com a Rússia”, disse Wadephul, citando isso como a segunda razão para as negociações. “Há uma ameaça de fome na região, e é por isso que defendo um cessar-fogo no Mar Negro”, acrescentou. As relações entre Moscou e Berlim, um aliado próximo da Ucrânia, estão congeladas desde a invasão russa, e Wadephul afirmou que o silêncio diplomático havia sido necessário. “Mas agora chegou o momento em que acreditei que precisávamos conversar”, disse Wadephul. Em um sinal de que a tensão persiste, Lavrov disse em uma coletiva de imprensa que não foi falado nada de novo com seu homólogo alemão que Berlim já não tivesse dito publicamente. “Eu disse a ele, francamente... você poderia simplesmente ter me ligado e dito: ‘leia minha declaração’”, disse Lavrov. Wadephul respondeu dizendo que é assim que alguém reage quando não tem argumentos e está em uma posição bastante fraca. “A Rússia não consegue explicar ao mundo por que continua essa guerra”, disse Wadephul, acrescentando: “É um absurdo, custa milhares de vidas.”

item.title: Giant pandas arrive at Zoo Atlanta for 10-year stay
item.description: Atlanta's newest celebrities arrived in style on Sunday, as two giant pandas from China touched down at Hartsfield-Jackson airport aboard a jumbo jet dubbed the FedEx Panda Express.
item.dc:creator: Ahmed Aboulenein
item.content:encoded: Atlanta's newest celebrities arrived in style on Sunday, as two giant pandas from China touched down at Hartsfield-Jackson airport aboard a jumbo jet dubbed the FedEx Panda Express. Two years after the city sent its last bears home to China, giant pandas Ping Ping and Fu Shuang landed to take up residence at Zoo Atlanta, one of three US zoos to house the bears. Chinese President Xi Jinping [USN:L6N45G10S TEXT:"said during a state visit"] on Thursday that the pandas would soon be on their way. Xi described them as "an envoy of friendship" between China and the US. China claims ownership of all the world's pandas and leases them to foreign zoos in a practice known as [USN:L4N3IG066 TEXT:""panda diplomacy.""] Any cubs born abroad remain Chinese property. The pair traveled to Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport aboard a dedicated Boeing 777 emblazoned with a panda logo, with FedEx donating the transport costs, Zoo Atlanta said. "This is a thrilling day for Zoo Atlanta and a historic moment for the City of Atlanta, the state of Georgia, and beyond," Zoo Atlanta President Raymond King said in a statement. Both bears were born in 2020 at the Chengdu Research Base of Giant Panda Breeding. They will spend about a month in quarantine at the Atlanta facility's new panda complex before going on public view. "Ping Ping and Fu Shuang are currently behind the scenes completing a routine quarantine period, so they are not yet visible," the zoo said. The pandas arrived under a new conservation agreement between the zoo and the China Wildlife Conservation Association and will stay for 10 years. Zoo Atlanta previously housed pandas from 1999 to 2024. The pair Lun Lun and Yang Yang produced seven offspring, including two sets of twins, before returning to China in October 2024. National Zoo, in Washington, D.C., and the San Diego Zoo also have giant pandas on loan from China. Once classified as endangered, giant pandas were reclassified by the International Union for Conservation of Nature as vulnerable in 2016. The organization estimates that nearly 1,900 remain in the wild, most of them protected on nature reserves in China.

item.title: Pope Leo commits to ending abuse by priests in meeting with French survivors, Vatican says
item.description: Pope Leo reaffirmed his commitment to ending abuse by priests in the Catholic Church during a meeting in Lourdes with seven survivors of abuse by French clergy, the Vatican said on Sunday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Pope Leo reaffirmed his commitment to ending abuse by priests in the Catholic Church during a meeting in Lourdes with seven survivors of abuse by French clergy, the Vatican said on Sunday. The pope "thanked them for their painful testimony and reaffirmed his commitment to ensuring that the harm they experienced is not repeated for others," said a statement. Leo is on a whirlwind three-city, four-day visit to France, where local bishops hope his visit will help repair the Church's standing after a crushing 2021 report on abuse of children by priests sparked nationwide shock.

item.title: Bill Gates faz coro aos apelos por medidas de proteção relacionadas à IA
item.description: A inteligência artificial exige medidas de proteção que vão além da autorregulação, afirmou o cofundador da Microsoft, Bill Gates, em uma entrevista exibida neste domingo, pedindo que o Congresso norte-americano aprove uma legislação.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A inteligência artificial exige medidas de proteção que vão além da autorregulação, afirmou o cofundador da Microsoft, Bill Gates, em uma entrevista exibida neste domingo, pedindo que o Congresso norte-americano aprove uma legislação. “É preciso que as autoridades e os políticos participem da discussão sobre como devem ser essas medidas de segurança e monitoramento”, disse Gates em uma entrevista gravada para o programa “Meet the Press”, da NBC. “E isso tem que ser obrigatório.” Uma onda repentina de apoio à intervenção federal ganhou força depois que a OpenAI informou, em julho, que um agente autônomo de IA saiu do controle durante um teste de segurança e invadiu outra empresa, subvertendo o controle humano. Gates se juntou a esse coro, afirmando que o governo precisa se envolver. “Ninguém acredita que a autorregulação seja suficiente”, afirmou. Em uma rara demonstração de união, CEOs das rivais Anthropic, OpenAI, DeepMind -- do Google (GOOGL.O) --, Microsoft (MSFT.O) e xAI pediram que uma desaceleração no desenvolvimento de sistemas de IA cada vez mais avançados. Mas o presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, e outros que se opõem a uma regulamentação adicional para a IA afirmam que novas restrições governamentais simplesmente dariam à China a vantagem na revolução da IA. Trump rejeitou publicamente os apelos por novas leis sobre IA. Gates argumentou que as medidas de proteção não prejudicariam drasticamente o setor e que os riscos de não implementá-las são reais. Gates acrescentou que deseja se encontrar com Trump para discutir a IA. “Espero que, considerando o trabalho de toda a minha vida nessa área, o fato de eu dizer o quanto isso é único e diferente e o quanto estou preocupado contribua para o que ele está ouvindo de outras pessoas”, disse Gates. A Axios informou que o presidente-executivo da Anthropic, Dario Amodei, jantará no domingo com Trump na Casa Branca. A Anthropic e a Casa Branca não responderam imediatamente a um pedido de comentário sobre a reportagem da Axios. Os alertas sobre os riscos da IA não são novidade. Mas eles ganharam maior urgência neste mês após pesquisadores dos principais laboratórios de IA atribuírem um prazo e uma probabilidade a essas preocupações.

item.title: Hezbolá prevé contribuir a proyecto para alojar a miles de libaneses desplazados, según su líder
item.description: El grupo libanés Hezbolá, respaldado por Irán, afirmó el domingo que pronto contribuiría a un proyecto destinado a proporcionar alojamiento a miles de personas desplazadas a causa de la guerra con Israel.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El grupo libanés Hezbolá, respaldado por Irán, afirmó el domingo que pronto contribuiría a un proyecto destinado a proporcionar alojamiento a miles de personas desplazadas a causa de la guerra con Israel. El anuncio lo realizó el líder de Hezbolá, Naim Qassem, durante un discurso en conmemoración del segundo aniversario del asesinato del líder Hassan Nasrallah a manos de Israel en 2024. "El partido (Hezbolá) se compromete a proporcionar refugio, rehabilitación y reconstrucción con los recursos disponibles y las donaciones. Muy pronto se darán a conocer los detalles de un nuevo proyecto de vivienda para los residentes de las aldeas que quedaron completamente destruidas", afirmó Qassem. Qassem señaló que el Estado libanés debería haber asumido la responsabilidad de dar cobijo e indemnizar a los desplazados. "Sigue siendo su deber cumplir con su responsabilidad en materia de alojamiento, indemnización y todas las obligaciones relacionadas con la reconstrucción y la restauración", afirmó. Más de un millón de personas, lo que representa casi una cuarta parte de la población del Líbano, quedaron desplazadas tras el estallido de una nueva guerra entre el ejército israelí y Hezbolá a principios de marzo. La mayoría ha regresado a sus hogares, pero más de 340.000 siguen desplazadas porque sus localidades quedaron destruidas o se encuentran en zonas ocupadas por el ejército israelí. Desde el 2 de marzo, los ataques israelíes han causado la muerte de más de 4.300 personas en el Líbano, entre ellas más de 250 niños, y han herido a otras 12.000, incluidos un millar de niños.

item.title: Israel revokes diplomatic status of Dutch diplomats in Ramallah
item.description: Israel said on Sunday it was revoking the diplomatic status of Dutch diplomats who represent the Netherlands at the Ramallah-based Palestinian Authority, in response to Dutch sanctions targeting Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Israel said on Sunday it was revoking the diplomatic status of Dutch diplomats who represent the Netherlands at the Ramallah-based Palestinian Authority, in response to [USN:L5N3UY0D3 TEXT:"Dutch sanctions"] targeting Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank. Israel earlier this month ordered the [USN:S8N44F000 TEXT:"closure of the British Consulate"] in East Jerusalem, which is Britain's representative with the Palestinian Authority, after London announced similar [USN:S8N42N05Y TEXT:"sanctions"] banning the import of goods from settlements. Israeli Foreign Minister Gideon Saar said on X that Dutch diplomats operating in Ramallah must return their Israeli-issued diplomatic documentation within seven days, when their diplomatic privileges and immunities are due to expire. "Any country that acts in a hostile and unilateral manner against Israel will lose influence and relevance in the region," Saar said. The Dutch Foreign Ministry declined to comment. The Netherlands' ban on imports of goods produced in settlements came into effect last week. Israel in August banned Dutch diplomats from a US-led coordination centre for Gaza that is based in Israel, over what the foreign minister described as "anti-Israel measures." Many countries, including the Netherlands, have long had diplomats who represent their governments with the Palestinian Authority in Ramallah while living in East Jerusalem. Israel has traditionally accredited those diplomats and granted them certain privileges under the Vienna Convention on treatment of diplomatic missions. France and Canada joined Britain this month in announcing a ban on goods from settlements, but Israel has not taken any action against those two countries. Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's right-wing government has found itself [USN:L8N45F07N TEXT:"diplomatically isolated"] from many of its allies over its conduct in recent years in Gaza and the West Bank. Two prominent Israeli cabinet ministers have been sanctioned by several countries, while Spain, Ireland and others have also announced a ban on goods originating from settlements.

item.title: ATP roundup: Alexander Zverev, Europe sail to Laver Cup victory
item.description: World No. 2 Alexander Zverev of Germany finished off Learner Tien 7-6 (3), 6-3, and Team Europe clinched a dominant 13-5 win over Team World at the Laver Cup on Sunday in London.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: World No. 2 Alexander Zverev of Germany finished off Learner Tien 7-6 (3), 6-3, and Team Europe clinched a dominant 13-5 win over Team World at the Laver Cup on Sunday in London. Europe led the competition 7-5 after two days, and each match was worth three points on the third and final day, with the first team to 13 points declared the winners. The final day started with doubles, in which Italy's Flavio Cobolli and the Czech Republic's Jakub Mensik prevailed 7-5, 6-3 over a pair of top-10 players in the world, Aussie Alex de Minaur and American Taylor Fritz. With just one more match win required for Europe to prevail, Zverev did his part by striking 32 winners to Tien's 21 and saving all four break points he faced. The other two matches of the day -- which would have featured Spaniards Carlos Alcaraz and Rafael Jodar against de Minaur and Fritz, respectively -- were not needed. Team World had won three of the past four Laver Cups before Europe's strong showing in London. The 2027 Laver Cup will be played in Los Angeles. Hangzhou Open Top-two seeds Daniil Medvedev and Andrey Rublev both outlasted their opponents in three sets to advance to the semifinals in China. Medvedev, the top seed, took down Coleman Wong of Hong Kong 6-3, 6-7 (2), 6-3 in a two-hour, 18-minute match. Medvedev saved five of six break points and converted 50 of his 63 first-serve points (79.4%). Rublev had a little more trouble against France's Hugo Gaston but prevailed 6-7 (6), 7-6 (4), 6-1 after two hours and 52 minutes. Rublev had 15 break-point opportunities and converted five of them while saving just two of five break points. He jumped out to a 5-0 lead in the deciding set. Rublev will face Kyrian Jacquet of France, who took down sixth-seeded Hungarian Fabian Marozsan 7-6 (12), 6-4. Medvedev will take on Roman Safiullin, who took care of China's Yunchaokete Bu 6-3, 6-3. Chengdu Open Spain's Alejandro Davidovich Fokina cruised past qualifier Alexandre Muller of France 6-1, 7-5 to reach the semifinals in China. Davidovich Fokina had a dominant serve and didn't face a break point while converting 13 of 16 second-serve points (81.3%). He converted three of seven break points in the one-hour, 20-minute match. Davidovich Fokina will next face Georgian qualifier Nikoloz Basilashvili, who defeated Jenson Brooksby 6-4, 7-6 (4). No. 5 seed Hubert Hurkacz of Poland took down qualifier Lloyd Harris 7-6 (10), 6-4. Hurkacz allowed eight break-point opportunities but was broken just once. No. 7 seed Denis Shapovalov of Canada will take on Hurkacz in the semifinals after defeating France's Adrian Mannarino 6-7 (6), 6-3, 6-2. --Field Level Media

item.title: WTA roundup: Czechs top Ukraine to win BJK Cup
item.description: Karolina Muchova and Linda Noskova won their singles matches to lead the Czech Republic to a 2-0 victory over Ukraine in the final of the Billie Jean King Cup on Sunday in Shenzhen, China.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Karolina Muchova and Linda Noskova won their singles matches to lead the Czech Republic to a 2-0 victory over Ukraine in the final of the Billie Jean King Cup on Sunday in Shenzhen, China. Muchova topped Anhelina Kalinina 6-2, 6-3. Noskova defeated Elina Svitolina 6-3, 7-6 (5) in the second match to clinch the Czech Republic's first BJK Cup since 2018. Overall, the Czechs have won 12 of their 13 appearances in the event final. This was the second appearance in the final four of the Billie Jean King Cup Finals for Ukraine, which reached the semifinals in 2025. Sunday's event was the first final for Ukraine, which dethroned two-time defending champion Italy in the semifinals to reach the final. Singapore Tennis Open Leylah Fernandez of Canada won her first title of 2026, capturing nine consecutive games to defeat Australian Talia Gibson 7-5, 6-0. It was the first career final for Gibson, who lost her serve at 5-5 in the first set to open the door for Fernandez to win in one hour, 38 minutes. Fernandez closed out the first set with three wins in a row, then dominated the second set. For the match, she converted six of 12 break chances. Gibson mustered just 12 points in the second set - nine on her own serve, three on her returns. Korea Open Kimberly Birrell defeated Maya Joint 6-4, 6-2 to earn her first WTA Tour title in the first all-Australian singles final on the tour in nearly 10 years. Joint jumped out to a 2-0 lead, but Birrell cashed in on two service breaks to win four straight games and go on to win the set. Breaks also were key in the second set, with Joint losing all four games on her serve. Birrell converted six of 10 break points overall, while Joint converted three of six break points to keep her in the 83-minute match. Joint struck 41 unforced errors against 12 winners, with Birrell posting 10 winners and 21 unforced errors. --Field Level Media

item.title: Serbia's President Vucic resigns ahead of October parliamentary elections
item.description: Serbia's populist President Aleksandar Vucic announced his resignation on Sunday, ending his second and final five-year term and paving the way for early presidential elections.
item.dc:creator: Aleksandar Vasovic
item.content:encoded: Serbia's populist President [USN:L6N4310JT TEXT:"Aleksandar Vucic"] announced his resignation on Sunday, ending his second and final five-year term and paving the way for early presidential elections. Vucic's resignation, seven months before his term ends, comes amid campaigning for Serbia's October 25 snap parliamentary vote and allows him to be appointed prime minister if his Serbian Progressive Party (SNS) forms the new government. He had said in late June that [USN:L6N42Z0F6 TEXT:"he planned to resign"] and that Serbia would hold early parliamentary and presidential elections. Rights groups have accused Vucic and his allies of increasingly authoritarian rule, with anti-government protesters saying they have been beaten by police and unfairly detained. Authorities have denied those allegations. On Sunday, hundreds of Vucic's supporters cheered him in front of the Presidency building in Belgrade's city centre. "This is the last evening for me in this building," he told the flag-waving crowd minutes before resigning. "I have faithfully served you and my fatherland, Serbia, ... I am proud of what we have done together," he said. Under Serbia's constitution, outgoing Parliament Speaker Ana Brnabic will serve as interim president until a new one is elected. The presidential election must be completed within 90 days, with the campaign lasting between 30 and 60 days. "By the end of December ... we will have the first round of presidential elections," Vucic said. ELECTIONS TO TEST VUCIC'S CONTROL Next month's snap parliamentary election will pit Vucic's SNS and its allies against Students Win, a student-led anti-corruption movement, and European Serbia, an alliance of pro-Western opposition parties. Students Win, European Serbia and other parties have yet to nominate their presidential candidates. Vucic, 56, has dominated Serbian politics for [USN:L6N4310JT TEXT:"more than a decade"]. He was a hardline nationalist and information minister during the era of the late Slobodan Milosevic and the wars of the 1990s, and later served as deputy prime minister from 2012-14 and prime minister from 2014-17. He moved to the largely ceremonial position of president in 2017, but kept tight control over his party and the government. In foreign policy, Vucic has pursued a balancing act that seeks closer ties with China, a major investor, and Russia, Serbia's principal supplier of natural gas, while maintaining a long-term goal of joining the EU. He also has sought to bolster ties with the United States and Israel. Vucic's term in office suffered a major blow in November 2024 when an awning of a newly reconstructed railway station in the northern city of Novi Sad collapsed, killing 16 people. The disaster sparked nationwide protests by students and the opposition, who demanded accountability for those responsible, transparency in public procurement, an end to systemic corruption, and an early parliamentary vote. The government repeatedly denied accusations by the protesters, although several officials, including two ministers, were arrested or resigned after the incident. On Sunday, Vucic said he has granted amnesty and a pardon to 49 people, including 12 activists and 11 of his own supporters, who were arrested or tried in connection with the protests.

item.title: Manifestantes impedem marcha da Ordem de Orange por área católica na Irlanda do Norte
item.description: Cerca de 2.000 manifestantes impediram que um desfile protestante atravessasse a área católica de uma cidade da Irlanda do Norte neste domingo, criando um impasse em que os dois lados recusavam-se a recuar, enquanto a polícia, posicionada entre eles, mantinha distância.
item.dc:creator: Cathal McNaughton, Amanda Ferguson
item.content:encoded: Cerca de 2.000 manifestantes impediram que um desfile protestante atravessasse a área católica de uma cidade da Irlanda do Norte neste domingo, criando um impasse em que os dois lados recusavam-se a recuar, enquanto a polícia, posicionada entre eles, mantinha distância. A tentativa de realizar o desfile pela cidade de Portadown ocorreu após o fim de uma proibição de quase 30 anos sobre o controverso trajeto, mas os participantes foram impedidos por multidões, incluindo a primeira-ministra da Irlanda do Norte, Michelle O’Neill, do partido nacionalista irlandês Sinn Fein. Os manifestantes, entre os quais também estava a líder do Sinn Fein, Mary Lou McDonald, se reuniram sob chuva na Garvaghy Road durante a madrugada, após o Tribunal Superior de Belfast, em uma sessão realizada tarde da noite, indeferir um pedido dos moradores para impedir o desfile. APELOS À CALMA As tentativas anuais da Ordem Orange, de origem protestante, de marchar pela área provocavam agitação em toda a região administrada pelos britânicos antes que o trajeto fosse proibido em 1998, mesmo ano em que o Acordo da Sexta-Feira Santa pôs fim, em grande parte, a três décadas de violência. “Isso é loucura”, disse McDonald a jornalistas na rua, um enclave católico na cidade predominantemente protestante de Portadown. “Na verdade, trata-se de um tratamento primitivo para qualquer comunidade no ano de 2026. É intolerável.” Os líderes da Irlanda e do Reino Unido, que são cogarantes do acordo de paz, pediram calma. “Houve grandes avanços na Irlanda do Norte e não queremos ver as coisas retrocederem”, disse o primeiro-ministro britânico, Andy Burnham à BBC. O primeiro-ministro irlandês, Micheal Martin, compartilhou da preocupação de Burnham, mas também considerou “incompreensível” e “errada” a decisão da Comissão de Desfiles da Irlanda do Norte de permitir o desfile. A comissão, que regula as marchas na região administrada pelos britânicos, autorizou na sexta-feira que um grupo menor do que o habitual, de 35 pessoas, participasse da marcha entre as 8h e as 9h30. Inicialmente, ela havia mantido a proibição para o desfile deste ano, mas a decisão foi anulada pelo Tribunal Superior em agosto devido a um erro processual. FAIXAS LARANJAS E CHAPÉUS-COCO Um pequeno grupo de membros da Ordem de Orange, vestindo tradicionais faixas de seda laranja e chapéus-coco pretos, reuniu-se em outra parte da cidade, mas não iniciaram a marcha. Um membro sênior disse à BBC que eles esperariam até que a polícia lhes informasse que o trajeto estava liberado. Vans da polícia estacionadas perto da Garvaghy Road, ladeadas por policiais em equipamento anti-motim, transmitiram avisos de que qualquer pessoa que participasse do protesto estaria cometendo um crime. A disputa explodiu em meados da década de 1990 quando, na esteira dos cessar-fogos dos principais grupos guerrilheiros da Irlanda do Norte, tornou-se um símbolo do conflito mais amplo entre nacionalistas predominantemente católicos, que se consideram irlandeses, e protestantes leais ao Reino Unido. Os Orangemen, cujo nome deriva do rei protestante Guilherme de Orange -- que derrotou o rei católico deposto Jaime 2º na Batalha do Boyne em 1690 --, afirmam que os desfiles fazem parte de sua tradição cultural protestante. Embora a maioria dos desfiles que ocorrem anualmente em toda a Irlanda do Norte não gere controvérsias, nacionalistas afirmam que os desfiles que passam por áreas católicas são uma demonstração ofensiva de triunfalismo destinada a intimidá-los.

item.title: Thompson fires Chelsea to 1-0 WSL win over Arsenal
item.description: Chelsea winger Alyssa Thompson scored the only goal as her side held off Arsenal to claim a tense 1-0 Women's Super League victory at Stamford Bridge on Sunday.
item.dc:creator: Philip O'connor
item.content:encoded: Chelsea winger Alyssa Thompson scored the only goal as her side held off Arsenal to claim a tense 1-0 Women's Super League victory at Stamford Bridge on Sunday. Leaders Manchester City remain top after they beat bottom club Charlton Athletic to make it four wins from four, but Sonia Bompastor's unbeaten Chelsea underlined their title ambitions by inflicting Arsenal's first defeat of the season. Arsenal were far better in the opening exchanges, but their lack of end product was punished when Thompson pounced in the 39th minute to slam home a rebound. The visitors pushed for an equaliser, but despite riding their luck at times, Chelsea were able to hang on for a result that left them third in the table on 10 points. The day's most impressive performance came from free-scoring Tottenham Hotspur, who hammered struggling Aston Villa 4-0. Victoria Pelova netted twice for Spurs, who are second in the table on 10 points, ahead of Chelsea thanks to their goal difference of +13. Japanese substitute Suzu Amano scored three minutes from time as Birmingham City snatched a 3-3 draw at home to Crystal Palace, and Manchester United grabbed their first win of the WSL season in a 2-1 home victory over West Ham United. Spain international Alexia Putellas got her first WSL goal when London City Lionesses beat Brighton & Hove Albion 2-0 on Saturday to leave them in fourth place on nine points, two ahead of fifth-placed Liverpool, who continued their solid start to the season with a 2-0 win over Everton in the Merseyside derby.

item.title: MLB sets wild-card series game times
item.description: MLB announced the game times for all four of its 2026 wild-card series Sunday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: MLB announced the game times for all four of its 2026 wild-card series Sunday. The full playoff field was not yet set, with the American League West champion and the National League's final wild-card spot still to be determined in Game 162, but both matchups involving those teams were known based on the standings. Each series is best-of-three and will be played from Tuesday through Thursday (if necessary). The East Coast prime-time spot went to the American League series between the Boston Red Sox and New York Yankees in New York. All three games between the league's top two wild cards are scheduled to begin at 8 p.m. ET, but Game 3 might move to 7 p.m. ET if other series end early. Start times for the other series are equally consistent. The other AL series has all three games scheduled for 5 p.m. ET. The West champion, which will be either the Texas Rangers or Houston Astros based on Sunday's games, will host the Chicago White Sox, the AL's third wild-card team. The series will be played in Arlington, Texas, or Houston. In the National League, first pitch for each game in the series between the third wild card, either the Philadelphia Phillies or the Arizona Diamondbacks, and the East Division champion Atlanta Braves is set for 2 p.m. ET in Atlanta. The other series, a rematch of last year's wild-card series between the San Diego Padres and Chicago Cubs, has all three games set for 10 p.m. ET in San Diego. All wild-card series games will air on NBC or NBC Sports Network (NBCSN) and stream on Peacock. --Field Level Media

item.title: France Le Rassemblement national aura un groupe au Sénat, une première
item.description: Le Rassemblement national sera en mesure de composer un groupe au Sénat, soit au moins 10 élus, ce qui sera une première pour la formation d'extrême-droite, à l'issue des élections sénatoriales de ce dimanche qui a vu le renouvellement de la moitié des sièges de la Chambre haute du Parlement.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Le Rassemblement national sera en mesure de composer un groupe au Sénat, soit au moins 10 élus, ce qui sera une première pour la formation d'extrême-droite, à l'issue des élections sénatoriales de ce dimanche qui a vu le renouvellement de la moitié des sièges de la Chambre haute du Parlement. "Pour la première fois de son histoire, le Rassemblement national va constituer, avec ses alliés de l'UDR (Union des Droites pour la République) du président Eric Ciotti, un groupe au Sénat", affirmé Jordan Bardella, sur la plate-forme X. Les résultats n'ont pas encore été officialisés à ce stade mais, d'après les projection de la chaîne Public Sénat, Les Républicains restent le premier parti représenté, avec 125 élus, contre 131 précédemment. Le groupe Socialiste, écologiste et républicain reste le deuxième parti avec 63 sièges (-1). Autre première, La France Insoumise fait son entrée au Sénat, avec un siège remporté dans le département du Rhône. Premier parti d'opposition à l'Assemblée nationale, le RN de Marine Le Pen, candidate à l'élection présidentielle de 2027, comptait trois sénateurs avant le scrutin de ce dimanche. "C'est une victoire historique et une étape majeure qui est franchie avec la constitution pour la première fois d'un groupe au Sénat. Les résultats vont au-delà de ce que nous pouvions espérer, la percée est générale, confirmant l'accélération de l'implantation du Rassemblement national sur tout le territoire", a dit pour sa part Marine Le Pen sur X. Ces élections sénatoriales étaient le dernier scrutin avant les élections présidentielles du printemps 2027, pour lesquelles, d'après les sondages, Marine Le Pen est donnée largement en tête dans les intentions de vote au premier tour. Un total de 178 sièges - sur 348 - était remis en jeu cette année à la chambre haute, renouvelée à 50% tous les trois ans via un collège de quelque 94.000 "grands électeurs", maires et délégués de conseils municipaux pour la plupart. La possibilité offerte au RN de former un groupe au Sénat - où les nouveaux élus le sont pour six ans - est la conséquence directe de la percée du parti lors des élections municipales de mars, en particulier dans les communes du pourtour méditerranéen. Au Sénat, la droite républicaine est majoritaire depuis les années 1970 - à l'exception d'une parenthèse socialiste entre 2011 et 2014.

item.title: Armani lança coleção cintilante em busca de “evolução”
item.description: A grife Giorgio Armani apresentou, neste domingo, uma coleção de moda feminina que combinou sua característica alfaiataria com tecidos cintilantes, enquanto o grupo de luxo italiano atravessa um período de transição um ano após a morte de seu fundador.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A grife Giorgio Armani apresentou, neste domingo, uma coleção de moda feminina que combinou sua característica alfaiataria com tecidos cintilantes, enquanto o grupo de luxo italiano atravessa um período de transição um ano após a morte de seu fundador. Intitulada “Evolução”, a nova coleção de Silvana Armani -- sobrinha do falecido estilista -- apresentou uma paleta de cores em marfim, preto e dourado e destacou jaquetas com ombros marcantes inspiradas nos anos 80, combinadas com calças na altura do joelho, geometrias ousadas e vestidos de noite que se ajustam ao corpo. “O estilo é uma forma de ser, e não um código imutável: a capacidade de mudar sem deixar de ser fiel a si mesmo”, afirmou o grupo em notas que acompanharam seu desfile no Teatro Armani, um dos edifícios da sede do grupo em Milão. Observando que “a identidade pode evoluir”, o grupo acrescentou ainda que as borboletas presentes em broches e colares simbolizavam a metamorfose. Em declarações à imprensa após o desfile, Silvana Armani reafirmou seu compromisso com a continuidade da estética da marca, ao mesmo tempo em que abre espaço para uma “evolução”, citando a introdução do algodão como exemplo de mudança. A grife italiana está entrando em um período crucial, à medida que começa a contagem regressiva para os planos de vender uma participação inicial de 15% a investidores externos. O presidente-executivo, Giuseppe Marsocci, afirmou que o grupo está aberto a investidores na venda de ações, acrescentando que nenhuma decisão havia sido tomada. No início do mês, o grupo nomeou Dario Vitale diretor criativo da Emporio Armani e da linha de acessórios da Giorgio Armani, marcando a primeira vez que alguém de fora da família Armani assumiu essa função.

item.title: Suíça rejeita regras de neutralidade que teriam restringido cooperação com Otan
item.description: Eleitores suíços rejeitaram categoricamente neste domingo uma proposta que adotaria uma forma mais restritiva de neutralidade e poderia impedir o país de impor sanções econômicas ou cooperar com a Otan.
item.dc:creator: Marleen Kaesebier, John Revill
item.content:encoded: Eleitores suíços rejeitaram categoricamente neste domingo uma proposta que adotaria uma forma mais restritiva de neutralidade e poderia impedir o país de impor sanções econômicas ou cooperar com a Otan. Todos os cantões e cerca de 70% dos eleitores rejeitaram a proposta de incluir na Constituição suíça uma definição mais rígida de neutralidade, segundo os resultados finais divulgados pelo Escritório Federal de Estatística. “Este resultado não é um voto contra a neutralidade. A Suíça era neutra ontem, é neutra hoje e continuará neutra no futuro”, afirmou o ministro das Relações Exteriores, Ignazio Cassis, em uma coletiva de imprensa após o anúncio do resultado. Embora a neutralidade suíça seja internacionalmente reconhecida desde o fim das guerras napoleônicas, em 1815, a forma como o governo a implementa não está explícita. O Partido Popular Suíço (SVP), de direita, afirmou que a posição tradicional da Suíça ficou prejudicada após Berna impor sanções à Rússia após a invasão da Ucrânia. A campanha financiou cartazes em todo o país instando as pessoas a votarem “Não à guerra, sim à neutralidade”, com pombas brancas da paz, antes da votação. Cassis afirmou que a rejeição permite que a Suíça continue decidindo sobre sanções econômicas caso a caso e coopere com parceiros quando isso fortalecer a segurança do país, a qual, segundo ele, também depende da segurança de seus vizinhos e do continente europeu.

item.title: France coach Zidane to ring changes for clash against Belgium
item.description: France coach Zinedine Zidane has promised changes to his side for Monday's Nations League match away to Belgium after losing captain Kylian Mbappe to injury.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: France coach Zinedine Zidane has promised changes to his side for Monday's Nations League match away to Belgium after losing captain Kylian Mbappe to injury. France beat Turkey 1-0 on Friday in Zidane’s first match in charge with Mbappe scoring the winner before being forced off. The forward has since returned to Real Madrid. "There will definitely be changes. How many, you will see tomorrow," a good-humoured Zidane told Sunday’s pre-match press conference. "But yes, we knew we were going to play four matches in a very short period, especially this one between Turkey and Belgium, with the travel in between. So obviously, we are going to rotate the team a little." The match in Brussels is the second of four for France during the international window. They host Italy in Paris on Friday before facing Belgium again at the Stade de France on Monday, October 5. Zidane said his immediate focus was on getting to know his players and helping them understand his demands, although results remained a priority. "Everything is important, but the most important thing is getting to know one another," he said. "The idea is always to prepare the matches properly, even if we don't have much training time, and especially because we can also do things through video. And then, of course, it's about winning the match because we're all competitors and when we step onto the pitch, we want to win." BELGIUM POSE TOUGH TEST Zidane expects a tough outing against Belgium, who beat Italy 2-0 in their opening Nations League Group A1 game in Rome on Friday. "There is also a coach (Mark van Bommel) on the other side who has just arrived and who will be putting things in place. It is a very good team. They had a very good World Cup and we know there are some outstanding individuals in this team. "And collectively, we know we're going to have a difficult match tomorrow. But that's what I find interesting. There are some great fixtures. That's what you want when you're competitive and enjoy playing football. You want to have big matches, and this is another one.” The 1998 World Cup winner said his players should savour the opportunity of playing for the national team. “There are some great matches ahead. You really have to enjoy the moment," Zidane said. "That's what I tell them because football goes so quickly. Look, I'm 54, I'm here now and I can't play anymore. So I tell them to enjoy the moment because it flies by, and the French national team is something so beautiful that I want them to experience these moments."

item.title: German foreign minister says Lavrov meeting driven by Russia security concerns
item.description: Wadephul said Russia's alleged deployment of armed drones at Leipzig airport had crossed a line.
item.dc:creator: Maria Martinez
item.content:encoded: German Foreign Minister Johann Wadephul said on Sunday his decision to meet Russian counterpart Sergei Lavrov was driven by security concerns and to address a growing food-export crisis. Lavrov and Wadephul [USN:L1N45I04M TEXT:"met in New York"] on the sidelines of the United Nations General Assembly on Saturday, marking the first such talks since before Russia's 2022 invasion of Ukraine. Wadephul said Russia's alleged deployment of armed drones at [USN:L8N44T1P2 TEXT:"Leipzig airport"] had crossed a line and made it necessary to communicate directly that Germany was prepared to defend itself. "Russia has to understand that we are ready to resist and to defend ourselves," Wadephul said in an interview with ARD. The meeting also came amid diplomatic efforts to revive Russia and Ukraine's Black Sea grain and energy exports that have been sharply curtailed by attacks on vessels and port infrastructure. "A number of colleagues, especially from the Global South, asked me to speak with Russia," Wadephul said, citing this as the second reason for the talks. "There is a threat of famine there, and that is why I am advocating for a ceasefire in the Black Sea," he added. Relations between Moscow and Berlin, a close ally of Ukraine, have been frozen since the Russian invasion and Wadephul said this diplomatic silence had been necessary. "But now the time had come when I believed we needed to talk," Wadephul said. In a sign of the continued frostiness, Lavrov told a news conference that he had learned nothing new from his German counterpart that Berlin had not already said publicly. "I told him that frankly ... you could just have called me and said: 'read my statement'," Lavrov said. Wadephul responded by saying that was how someone reacts when they have no arguments and are in a rather weak position. "Russia cannot explain to the world why it is continuing this war," Wadephul said, adding: "It is senseless, it costs thousands of lives."

item.title: Phillies activate LHP Jesus Luzardo off IL ahead of season finale
item.description: The Philadelphia Phillies reinstated All-Star left-hander Jesus Luzardo from the 15-day injured list prior to Sunday's critical game against the visiting Tampa Bay Rays.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Philadelphia Phillies reinstated All-Star left-hander Jesus Luzardo from the 15-day injured list prior to Sunday's critical game against the visiting Tampa Bay Rays. Right-hander Jose Urquidy was designated for assignment by the Phillies (87-74), who can clinch their fifth straight postseason berth on Sunday afternoon as they face the American League East champion Rays (98-63) in the regular-season finale for both teams. Philadelphia, which has lost four games in a row, holds a one-game lead over the Arizona Diamondbacks (86-75) for the final wild-card spot in the National League. The Phillies need to either win on Sunday or have the Diamondbacks lose to the host San Diego Padres in order to clinch a postseason berth. Luzardo, 28, was placed on the injured list Sept. 15, retroactive to Sept. 12, with left shoulder inflammation. After a breakout 2025, Luzardo is having his best season to date in 2026. The first-time All-Star is 14-5 with a 2.87 ERA across 29 starts. He already has set a career high with 221 strikeouts against 52 walks. In eight MLB seasons with the then-Oakland Athletics (2019-21), Miami Marlins (2021-24) and Phillies, Luzardo is 55-46 with a 3.92 ERA and two saves in 166 appearances (150 starts). He has 996 strikeouts in all, eclipsing 200 in three of the past four seasons. Urquidy, 31, pitched to a 3.68 ERA without a decision in two appearances with the Phillies after being claimed off waivers from the Chicago White Sox on Sept. 17. --Field Level Media

item.title: Irán insiste en una solución diplomática tras el rechazo de Trump al plan de paz
item.description: Irán insistió el domingo en que solo la diplomacia puede resolver su conflicto con Estados Unidos e Israel, después de que el presidente estadounidense, Donald Trump, afirmara que rechazaba una propuesta iraní para reabrir el estrecho de Ormuz y poner fin a los combates.
item.dc:creator: Trevor Hunnicutt, Yomna Ehab, Jana Choukeir
item.content:encoded: Irán insistió el domingo en que solo la diplomacia puede resolver su conflicto con Estados Unidos e Israel, después de que el presidente estadounidense, Donald Trump, afirmara que rechazaba una propuesta iraní para reabrir el estrecho de Ormuz y poner fin a los combates. "Nuestras condiciones son claras, y cualquier medida para reabrir el estrecho de Ormuz depende de que se cumplan dichas condiciones", publicó el ministro de Asuntos Exteriores iraní, Abbas Araqchi, en las redes sociales. "Solo una solución negociada puede sacarles de este punto muerto". Irán anunció la semana pasada una propuesta de paz en la Asamblea General de la ONU en Nueva York, afirmando que había sido transmitida a los estadounidenses a través de mediadores qataríes. Trump declaró el sábado que rechazaba el plan y argumentó que la desesperación estaba impulsando la presión de los iraníes para alcanzar un acuerdo sobre esta vía navegable clave. "Quieren llegar a un acuerdo para abrir el estrecho de Ormuz de inmediato porque están saliendo muy mal parados", declaró Trump a periodistas en la Casa Blanca. Sin embargo, dejando abierta la puerta a la diplomacia, Trump dijo a Axios en una entrevista telefónica el domingo que esperaba que los negociadores estadounidenses mantuvieran más conversaciones esta semana. Araqchi señaló que los mediadores que facilitan las conversaciones entre Teherán y Washington no habían transmitido oficialmente el rechazo estadounidense al plan. "Estamos a la espera de que los mediadores nos transmitan las opiniones definitivas, y tomaremos una decisión basándonos en ellas", publicó Araqchi. Estados Unidos ha impuesto un bloqueo económico a Irán para presionar a Teherán a fin de que ponga fin a los ataques iraníes contra buques en el estrecho de Ormuz, que han reducido drásticamente el tráfico marítimo en la zona, a pesar de que Trump afirme repetidamente que Estados Unidos controla esa vía navegable. El comandante en jefe del ejército iraní, Amir Hatam, afirmó que la guerra se encontraba en una fase crítica y decisiva, y añadió que Teherán no aceptaría una situación en la que no pudiera comerciar mientras las potencias extranjeras utilizaran las vías navegables estratégicas de la región. "Si Irán no puede comerciar, si Irán no puede vivir, nadie podrá comerciar ni vivir", afirmó, según comentarios difundidos por los medios de comunicación estatales. ARABIA SAUDITA SE VE ARRASTRADA AÚN MÁS A LA GUERRA Los intentos diplomáticos anteriores no han logrado poner fin a la guerra, que comenzó el 28 de febrero con ataques estadounidenses e israelíes contra Irán. Desde entonces, el conflicto ha alternado entre treguas y nuevos ataques, que han causado miles de víctimas mortales, al tiempo que han debilitado las fuerzas convencionales de Irán y han dañado su economía, ya de por sí en crisis. Irán y sus aliados han respondido extendiendo el conflicto por toda la región. Irán ha atacado a aliados de Estados Unidos en el Golfo con drones y misiles, mientras que sus aliados hutíes en Yemen han atacado intereses sauditas. Arabia Saudita, el mayor de los Estados del Golfo, se ha visto arrastrada aún más a la guerra este mes, a medida que los combatientes hutíes han avanzado en Yemen, derrotando a las fuerzas del Gobierno respaldado por Arabia Saudita y amenazando las exportaciones de petróleo sauditas a través del mar Rojo. Los hutíes, respaldados por Irán, han disparado repetidamente contra Arabia Saudita y, en lo que podría ser un indicio de una mayor escalada, los padres de Riad recibieron el domingo avisos de los colegios en los que se les informaba de que las clases pasarían a impartirse a distancia durante esa semana, según personas que recibieron los mensajes. La notificación no ofrecía ninguna razón que justificara la decisión. Las autoridades sauditas no respondieron de inmediato a una solicitud de comentarios. Por su parte, el ministerio de Sanidad yemení, controlado por los hutíes, afirmó que siete personas habían fallecido y 40 habían resultado heridas, entre ellas niños, en un ataque contra tiendas de un mercado situado en el cruce de Mawiya, en la provincia de Taiz, al suroeste del país. CONFLICTO HA INTERRUMPIDO EL FLUJO DE PETRÓLEO Los iraníes también mantuvieron conversaciones con sus rivales sauditas sobre el estrecho de Ormuz durante la breve ronda de negociaciones diplomáticas en Nueva York, lo que puso de relieve lo que está en juego en un conflicto que dura ya siete meses y que ha interrumpido el flujo de petróleo a través de una ruta marítima crucial y ha pasado factura a la economía mundial. Araqchi declaró el viernes a periodistas en la ONU que el acuerdo propuesto daría lugar a una cuenta atrás de siete días para la reapertura del estrecho y a una tregua en los combates regionales. El enviado de Estados Unidos ante Naciones Unidas, Mike Waltz, declaró el domingo en una entrevista en el programa State of the Union de la CNN que Trump había rechazado la propuesta iraní porque exigía el levantamiento inmediato de las sanciones y la liberación de los activos congelados. "En definitiva, pedían todo por adelantado a cambio de la promesa de que luego estarían dispuestos a negociar", explicó Waltz. "El presidente simplemente no confía en que los iraníes actúen de buena fe ni en que vayan a negociar de verdad el fin de su programa nuclear". El presidente iraní, Masoud Pezeshkian, en una entrevista en el programa de la CBS Face the Nation, afirmó que Teherán estaba dispuesto a mantener conversaciones sobre su programa nuclear y otras cuestiones, pero que no aceptaría "intimidaciones ni coacciones". "Irán no busca la guerra, pero se defenderá frente a la presión, las amenazas y los ataques", afirmó Pezeshkian, añadiendo que ya se había acordado que "no debemos desarrollar armas nucleares".

item.title: Foreign banks have expressed UBS merger interest, Swiss newspaper reports
item.description: Several major foreign banks have expressed their interest in a possible merger or combination with Switzerland's UBS , a Swiss newspaper said on Sunday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Several major foreign banks have expressed their interest in a possible merger or combination with Switzerland's UBS (UBSG.S) , a Swiss newspaper said on Sunday. At least eight banks have signalled interest to UBS, Blick reported, citing an insider with knowledge of the matter. UBS, which said it does not comment on speculation on the subject, was [USN:S8N3X701Y TEXT:"dealt a blow"] when Switzerland's upper house voted on Wednesday in favour of tougher capital rules that the bank estimates could require it to hold about $18 billion in additional capital. Ahead of the vote, chairman Colm Kelleher [USN:L8N4590VV TEXT:"warned"] that UBS could rethink its Swiss base if capital rules were too harsh. On Friday, Semafor reported that UBS management had revived discussions on ways to reduce its exposure to Swiss regulation, including through a possible combination with a foreign bank, citing people familiar with the matter. Switzerland's [USN:L8N45I067 TEXT:"finance minister, "]Karin Keller-Sutter, said at the weekend it was unlikely that UBS would leave its Swiss base as it would be more expensive than the new capital rules and legally complicated.

item.title: Kohli passes 15,000 ODI runs as India beat West Indies
item.description: Virat Kohli became only the second batter after Sachin Tendulkar to reach 15,000 ODI runs, achieving the milestone with an unbeaten century as India cruised to an eight-wicket victory over West Indies in the opening one-day international on Sunday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Virat Kohli became only the second batter after Sachin Tendulkar to reach 15,000 ODI runs, achieving the milestone with an unbeaten century as India cruised to an eight-wicket victory over West Indies in the opening one-day international on Sunday. Kohli struck 139 not out from 88 balls and Shubman Gill made 110 as India chased down 296 with 50 balls to spare to take a 1-0 lead in the three-match series. "I got a challenge at this stage of my career to kind of up the ante and play a gear to higher end, that was exciting for me to work on," Kohli said after the match in Thiruvananthapuram. "It excites you when you have to unlock a new version at this stage of your career, which will eventually help, you know, anything that you play for, be it playing for India or in the IPL. It's really helped me a lot to play with a free mind and I think that is what is working for me." Rohit Sharma and Gill launched the chase with a 74-run opening stand before Sharma was dismissed in the 12th over. Gill, the world's top-ranked ODI batter, then took control, maintaining the aggressive approach and bringing up his 10th ODI century with a sweep. Kohli came in at number three and notched up his 86th international century, while Gill struck 110 from 108 deliveries as the pair put on a dominant 151-run stand off 132 balls that all but sealed the contest. Roston Chase eventually removed Gill but Ruturaj Gaikwad made 13 off 19 balls and helped Kohli to steer India home without further alarm. Kohli sealed victory with successive boundaries. Put in to bat, Justin Greaves and John Campbell gave West Indies a strong start, adding 135 from 117 balls for the opening wicket. India struggled to find a breakthrough for much of the first 20 overs as the pair dominated the bowling and provided a solid platform. Greaves, who was dropped by Sharma on 16, made India pay with a maiden ODI century and top-scored for the visitors. The momentum shifted when Kuldeep Yadav dismissed Campbell in the 20th over, beating him in the air as he swept a catch to short fine leg. Yadav and Prasidh Krishna then applied the brakes as West Indies lost four wickets for 22 runs between the 31st and 36th overs. Yadav finished with 4-40 on his ODI return but Amir Jangoo counter-attacked with 58 off 43 balls. With support from Chase, he helped West Indies to recover from 198-5 and post 295.

item.title: Des frappes russes tuent cinq personnes dans trois villes ukrainiennes - autorités
item.description: Des attaques russes ont fait cinq morts dimanche en Ukraine, dans la capitale Kyiv et deux autres villes du pays, ont indiqué les autorités locales.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Des attaques russes ont fait cinq morts dimanche en Ukraine, dans la capitale Kyiv et deux autres villes du pays, ont indiqué les autorités locales. A Kyiv, une attaque de drone a frappé un marché dans la banlieue ouest de la ville, tuant deux personnes et en blessant 10 autres. Dans la ville de Soumy, au nord-est pays, fréquemment prise pour cible en raison de sa localisation près de la frontière, trois bombes sont tombées à proximité d'un centre d'aide aux familles, tuant deux personnes, écrit le gouverneur régional sur la messagerie Telegram. La Russie ne cache pas son intention de transformer certaines parties de la région de Soumy en zone tampon. À Kharkiv, deuxième ville d'Ukraine, également dans le nord-est et également souvent prise pour cible, un drone a touché une voiture, tuant le conducteur, ont indiqué les procureurs.
